scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical and elementary; the included exact-rational computation is a finite verification, not a substitute for the universal proof. No independent evaluation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the specified additive toral skew product with integer expansion and equal-interval observations under product Haar initial law; no claim for nonlinear forcing or arbitrary initial measures. A matching formulation in unindexed literature is not excluded.
title: Arithmetic Bernoulli threshold and persistent word correlations in an additive toral skew product
